items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: he sat Pepe Beque in a chair... and dancing around Pepe Beque... because the team was Cachao and Pepe Beque.

ctx.x: So he cannot dance, he just move a little bit.
You know what he did? In account that he could not dance, he sat Pepe Beque in a chair and he took one of the paper - ahh - I mean table ....
